items.unit: EUR/h (average hourly rate of mould production, China)
items.basis: TR Monitor (Turkish trade press) article on Chinese competition in mould making: 'The average hourly rate of mold production in Turkey is EUR 32, while in Portugal it is EUR 46.4. While this figure is EUR 53 in Italy, it is EUR 26 in China.' Ratios from the same source: CN / PT = 26 / 46.4 = 0.56; CN / IT = 26 / 53 = 0.49.
items.date: undated (article; year of the data not stated)
items.kind: trade press (country comparison, figure attributed to the industry)
items.scope: mould-shop hourly rate, all-in selling rate assumed (the article does not say what is included)
items.notes: LOW confidence: single source, year not stated, scope not stated, no UK figure in the same comparison so no direct ratio. Book check: CN toolroom factor 0.2366 → cnc £12.39/h, design £13.82/h, fitting £11.44/h; €26 × 0.858 = £22.3/h, i.e. 1.6–1.9× the book. Against the UK book cnc £52.37 (≈ €61) the ratio would be ≈ 0.43, not 0.24 — suggests the CN toolroom factor may be LOW, not proven. Excluded cross-checks: vendor blogs give CNC operator WAGES in China $8–15/h or $3–8/h (vendor claims, contradictory). Read from a web-search result snippet; page fetches are refused in this session (DNS / proxy), so the figure was not read on the page itself — re-read before it sets a rate.

notes: 18 web searches used. Page fetches are refused in this session (scribd.com, idtr.gov.in DNS-refused); every new figure was read from search-result snippets and is marked verify: true.

Published service price lists are rare in the UK, China and Poland: no UK £/kg heat treat, £/kg galvanise, £/m² powder / e-coat / anodise or MPI rate surfaced; the search engine returns little Chinese-language content.

No like-for-like UK v local pair was found for any service, so no sourced service factor (country-books.ts services) can be built from this file alone. The Hungary engineering 'from' price (£57/h) v the UK 'from' price (£50/h) would give an implausible factor — do not pair them.

Possible book issue (not proven): the China toolroom factor 0.2366 gives £12.39/h CNC / £13.82/h design; a single undated trade-press figure puts Chinese mould production at €26/h (≈ £22.3/h at 0.858), about 1.6–1.9× the book.
FX used in notes: book fxToGBP — HUF 437.75, PLN 5.096, INR 127.2, CNY 8.88; EUR 0.858 £/€ as in germany-2026-10 r2 file.
